subject.title: Expose structured progress metrics in hook events for plugin-based live progress cards

question: Should OpenClaw add a producer-owned structured progress metrics contract to plugin hook events, and which runtime source owns `stepTotal`, `percent`, ETA, and terminal metrics across embedded, CLI, and Codex paths?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the field names, semantics, terminal behavior, and source of truth become a public Plugin SDK API decision that automation should not invent.

options.title: Define a narrow metrics contract
options.body: Add optional metrics only when the runtime can produce authoritative values, omit unknown fields, and document/test semantics across relevant producers.

options.title: Use agent/process events instead
options.body: Keep tool and terminal hooks unchanged and make live-card plugins consume a separate structured event surface for progress state.

options.title: Keep hooks text-only
options.body: Leave plugins to derive progress from existing lifecycle/tool events and accept phase-only live cards until a stronger progress source exists.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow metrics contract
recommendation.body: Add optional metrics only when the runtime can produce authoritative values, omit unknown fields, and document/test semantics across relevant producers.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior run/tool hook correlation work is the closest current-main ownership trail for this public hook contract choice.
